tagline: A pastel kart racer for up to eight: fairytale animals, each with their own kart and perk, race three laps around Whispering Woods.
overview:
Great Outdoors is a cheerful online kart racer. Eight fairytale animals (Duck, Bunny, Deer, Coyote, Hawk, Bear, Wolf and Beaver) each drive their own kart with their own perk, in a soft pastel world. The track, Whispering Woods, is a forest loop of three laps with a dirt shortcut across the south-east bend, a patch of mud in the east and a ford through a stream in the north.

Item boxes along the track give one of three pickups: a Mushroom boost, an Acorn to throw, or a Bubble shield. Hop and hold to drift round corners and charge a boost. Bots fill the grid up to eight, so you can race alone on your own PC, or one player hosts and friends join. The camera follows from behind, and a gamepad works throughout.
story: The animals of the Great Outdoors hold a race through Whispering Woods: three laps round the forest, past the mud and through the ford. Pick your favourite and see whose kart is quickest.
goal: Finish three laps first. Every racer has 30 seconds to finish after the winner crosses the line.
rules: Pick your animal in the lobby and press Ready; bots fill the empty places on the grid.
Three laps of Whispering Woods, through every checkpoint gate in order.
Mud and water slow most karts; the dirt shortcut saves distance but slows karts that do not like dirt.
Drive through an item box for a pickup: Mushroom (boost), Acorn (throw it at someone) or Bubble (shield). Boxes come back after 6 seconds.
Hold hop through a corner to drift; a long drift releases a boost.
Each animal's perk changes how its kart drives (see Characters).

controls.input: W / S or up / down (right / left trigger)
A / D or left / right (left stick)

controls.action: Your animal's ability (the Beaver lays planks)

controls.input: Left / right in the lobby (d-pad, bumpers)

characters.name: Duck
characters.description: A round yellow duck with an orange bill in a rubber-duck kart. Perk: Water does not slow you down (the ford).

characters.name: Bunny
characters.description: A pink-and-white bunny with tall ears and a carrot on the nose of a mint kart. Perk: Light and nimble: a higher hop and faster hop-drifts.

characters.name: Deer
characters.description: A fawn deer with antlers in a leaf-green kart. Perk: Highest top speed, slow to accelerate; drifts charge much faster.

characters.name: Coyote
characters.description: A sandy coyote with a bushy tail in a terracotta kart on big dirt tyres. Perk: No penalty on the dirt shortcuts.

characters.name: Hawk
characters.description: A brown hawk with spread wings in a sky-blue kart with fins. Perk: Hold jump in the air to glide.

characters.name: Bear
characters.description: A big brown bear in a wide honey-coloured kart with a bumper. Perk: Heavy: bumps spin others, and you never spin.

characters.name: Wolf
characters.description: A grey-blue wolf with pointed ears in a lavender kart. Perk: Driving in another kart's slipstream charges a boost.

characters.name: Beaver
characters.description: A beaver in a kart made of logs and planks, with a flat tail. Perk: Unbothered by dirt, mud and water; E lays planks behind the kart.

tips: The Coyote and the Beaver love the dirt shortcut; the Duck and the Beaver laugh at the ford.
Bunny and Deer are drifters: hop into every corner.
With the Bear, bump people: they spin, you do not.
Hold an Acorn for the final straight.

prompt:
Only tier A. I also want to include a hosted kart racing game. Let’s have it themed around fairytale animals with a pastel color palette. Do only one map for the time being. The characters are:

Duck
Bunny
Deer
Coyote 
Hawk
Bear
Wolf
Beaver

Each character has their own unique kart with its own perks. 

I recognize this is a big ask, but I think the data gathered from it can really help us improve the engine (networking, game mechanics, character design, etc)
prompt_source: Given to Claude Code on 2026-09-29, as part of a larger request ("Only tier A" refers to an earlier list in the same conversation). Later feedback from the owner, 2026-10-01, asked for the clanging motor noise to go, smoother online play, and "its own unique music. Something light and fun! They're cute animals having a little race for pete sake".
